rounds: Two weeks of the same outfit, same routine, same going-through-the-motions. That's the Joy Police keeping things beige and they're winning that one. But you're still wearing the Apollo ring to work — every single day — and that's yours. The ring is on the finger. That's not nothing.
pattern: They're fine with you wearing the thing, as long as you never have to talk about it.
focus: Next time someone asks about the ring, give them one true sentence.
